description:
Run official Unity Test Framework tests and wait for structured results. Preserves NUnit lifecycle, UnityTest coroutines, parameterized cases, skips, and domain reload recovery. After changing or hot-reloading test code, complete unity_recompile before running. Requires workspace Unity Test tools and com.unity.test-framework >=1.4.0.

All parameters are optional; omit unused filter arrays. Runs start from Edit Mode and the framework controls Play Mode transitions. Cancellation/host timeout cancels the run; modal dialogs may delay cancellation until resolved. Plan mode blocks test execution.

mode.description: Optional Unity Test mode to run. Use edit|play to run both modes in one request; defaults to edit|play. Play Mode runs still start from Edit Mode and Unity Test Framework controls the transition.

groups.description: Optional Unity Test Framework group-name regular expressions.

timeout_ms.description: Host-side timeout in milliseconds for sync execution, clamped to 1000..3600000. Background async/notify execution has no time limit.

result_detail.description: Result detail returned to the agent. failures includes failure messages and stack traces; all includes every leaf result.
